title: AI Model Training & Inference Operations Core v2

domain.name: AI Model Training & Inference Operations
domain.description: Advanced AI model operations covering dataset governance, rigorous evaluation, adapter training, quantization, GPU efficiency, serving, multimodal pipelines, and lifecycle observability. Model/version-specific behavior belongs in Current Intelligence.

competencies.name: Advanced Dataset Governance & Quality
competencies.description: Manage dataset lineage, deduplication, contamination risk, rights, labeling standards, and change control.
competencies.purpose: Make training data auditable and evaluation trustworthy.

units.title: Dataset changes are model changes
units.content: Adding, removing, relabeling, filtering, or rebalancing data can alter behavior as materially as changing hyperparameters, so dataset versions need lineage and review.

units.title: Dataset release workflow
units.content: Record provenance and permitted use, deduplicate, define label policy, isolate sensitive or restricted material, freeze train/validation/test manifests, run contamination checks, version the dataset, and attach known gaps.

units.title: Dataset governance failures
units.content: Avoid mixing evaluation examples into training, losing source provenance, relabeling without versioning, retaining restricted data because it improved a metric, and comparing models trained on materially different datasets without noting it.

drills.title: Prepare a governed training dataset release
drills.prompt: Design the release record for a local fine-tuning dataset including provenance, dedupe, splits, exclusions, rights, and known gaps.

competencies.name: Evaluation & Regression Suites
competencies.description: Build layered evals with task metrics, rubrics, adversarial cases, latency, cost, and regression gates.
competencies.purpose: Detect quality gains and hidden regressions before model promotion.

units.title: One score cannot represent every failure mode
units.content: Capability, safety, formatting, hallucination, latency, memory, and task-specific reliability need separate categories because averages can hide severe regressions.

units.title: Regression-suite workflow
units.content: Freeze representative tasks, define category rubrics, include edge and adversarial cases, compare baseline and candidate, record per-category deltas, investigate regressions, and set promotion criteria before seeing results.

units.title: Evaluation failure modes
units.content: Avoid changing the benchmark after viewing candidate failures, cherry-picking demos, using model-as-judge without calibration, and promoting from average improvement when critical categories regress.

drills.title: Design a FREEOS regression suite
drills.prompt: Build an evaluation structure for coding, project knowledge, current-intelligence discipline, tool-use judgment, and creative tasks.

competencies.name: Advanced LoRA / PEFT Fine-Tuning
competencies.description: Design adapter experiments around rank, target modules, data mix, learning schedule, checkpoint selection, and merge/deploy strategy.
competencies.purpose: Adapt model behavior efficiently while preserving a reproducible base.

units.title: Adapter capacity should match the behavior change
units.content: More rank, target modules, or training steps increase capacity and cost but can overfit or overwrite useful base behavior if the task and data do not justify them.

units.title: Adapter experiment workflow
units.content: Define target behavior and frozen eval, choose base model and target modules, establish a small hyperparameter matrix, checkpoint regularly, compare against baseline, inspect overfit, and version adapter plus training config separately from the base.

units.title: Adapter-training failures
units.content: Avoid training on changing facts, merging adapters before evaluation, changing data and hyperparameters simultaneously, and keeping only final checkpoint when earlier checkpoints may generalize better.

drills.title: Plan an adapter training experiment
drills.prompt: Design a LoRA experiment to improve one stable FREEOS behavior while protecting general capability.

competencies.name: Quantization & Model Format Conversion
competencies.description: Evaluate precision, quantization methods, conversion pipelines, tokenizer/config integrity, and runtime compatibility.
competencies.purpose: Reduce memory and latency without silently degrading task quality.

units.title: Conversion can change behavior without changing model identity labels
units.content: Quantization, tensor layout, tokenizer handling, chat templates, and runtime kernels can affect quality and compatibility; converted artifacts need their own evaluation.

units.title: Conversion workflow
units.content: Record source model checksum/reference, choose target runtime and quantization based on hardware, convert once, verify tokenizer/config/template, run frozen eval and latency tests, record memory usage, and retain source and rollback artifact.

units.title: Conversion failures
units.content: Avoid assuming smaller quantization is automatically better, comparing converted models with different prompts, losing tokenizer metadata, and distributing a conversion that never passed task eval.

drills.title: Compare deployment quantizations
drills.prompt: Design a fair comparison among several quantization levels for a local assistant on constrained VRAM.

competencies.name: GPU Memory & Throughput Optimization
competencies.description: Tune context, KV cache, batch, precision, offload, kernel choices, concurrency, and model residency from measured workloads.
competencies.purpose: Use GPU resources efficiently without unstable OOM behavior.

units.title: Throughput, latency, and memory are coupled
units.content: Increasing batch or context can improve utilization or capability while increasing queueing, KV cache, peak VRAM, and latency; tuning needs workload-specific tradeoffs.

units.title: GPU tuning workflow
units.content: Define workload and latency target, measure cold/warm baseline, inspect peak VRAM and utilization, tune one variable at a time, test realistic context and concurrency, preserve headroom, and record stable settings per model.

units.title: GPU tuning failures
units.content: Avoid tuning from tokens-per-second alone, running at zero memory headroom, keeping duplicate models resident, changing driver/runtime and model settings simultaneously, and treating CPU offload as free.

drills.title: Tune an 8GB local inference workload
drills.prompt: Create a measurement plan for responsive FREEOS inference with realistic context, one concurrent job, and occasional heavier tasks.

competencies.name: Advanced Inference Serving & Queueing
competencies.description: Design local serving around request queues, streaming, cancellation, priority, batching, timeouts, health, and model load policy.
competencies.purpose: Make model-backed applications predictable under multiple tasks.

units.title: A model server is a scheduler
units.content: Even on one GPU, requests compete for model residency, context memory, compute, and queue time; service behavior needs explicit fairness and cancellation rules.

units.title: Serving-control workflow
units.content: Define request classes and timeout budgets, bound concurrency and queue length, support cancellation where runtime permits, stream interactive output, isolate long jobs, expose health/queue metrics, and test overload behavior.

units.title: Serving failure modes
units.content: Avoid unlimited queues, one long request starving interactive work, reporting cancellation when underlying compute continues, restarting the model for every timeout, and hiding queue wait inside generation latency.

drills.title: Design FREEOS model queue policy
drills.prompt: Plan serving for chat, autonomous jobs, and background evaluation on one local GPU.

competencies.name: Multimodal Pipeline Operations
competencies.description: Coordinate text, vision, audio, image, and video models through explicit representations, preprocessing, handoffs, and validation.
competencies.purpose: Build reliable local AI pipelines instead of assuming models share compatible inputs and semantics.

units.title: Multimodal pipelines fail at interfaces
units.content: Resolution, frame rate, sample rate, token limits, embeddings, coordinate systems, normalization, timestamps, and metadata can break handoffs even when each model works alone.

units.title: Multimodal workflow
units.content: Define each stage input/output contract, preserve timestamps and provenance, normalize media deliberately, test stages independently, cache expensive stable intermediates, and validate semantic alignment after each transformation.

units.title: Multimodal failures
units.content: Avoid silently resizing or resampling without tracking it, assuming coordinate systems align, chaining uncertain outputs as facts, and debugging the whole pipeline before proving each stage.

drills.title: Design a local video-understanding pipeline
drills.prompt: Plan frame/audio extraction, vision analysis, speech transcription, timeline alignment, and summary generation for a local video.

competencies.name: Model Lifecycle, Safety & Observability
competencies.description: Version models and adapters, monitor quality/latency/errors, canary changes, capture provenance, and roll back safely.
competencies.purpose: Operate models as governed production components rather than anonymous files.

units.title: The deployed behavior is a stack
units.content: Weights, adapter, tokenizer, template, system prompt, retrieval, runtime, quantization, context, and generation settings together define behavior and must be traceable.

units.title: Model promotion workflow
units.content: Create immutable candidate record, attach eval and hardware results, deploy to limited scope, monitor latency/errors/quality signals, compare against baseline, promote only when criteria pass, and keep rollback artifact and config.

units.title: Lifecycle failure modes
units.content: Avoid overwriting model files in place, changing prompts without versioning, promoting from anecdotal success, losing adapter/base pairing, and rolling back weights while leaving incompatible runtime settings active.

drills.title: Define a governed model promotion
drills.prompt: Create the release and rollback record for moving a new local model configuration into FREEOS.
